notes.title: New & updated screenshots.
notes.content:
Hi!

Thanks for following Vibur: Disintegration. This announcement is to let you know new screenshots have been posted alongside some that have been updated.

In this first update, the focus is in the visual novel scenes, as the art style has become slightly more refined, it was clear some past screenshots were in need of a reupload.

As for the new ones, they are only two:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35001658/8863b788f0e4b097a04b9d0aa29173d5d3ce453d.jpg[/img]
A moment when talking to a mechanic, also showing how some scenes are composed, with sprites in odd angles, to add variety from the standard scenes with “characters posed in a leveled camera”.


And the second screen, a press conference.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35001658/8dea705abe51ec01790d5d064eb44025474e429c.jpg[/img]
The Dygra faction has a tight relation to the press. And it is usual to after missions, Abidis pilots, the more overvalued personnel in the conflict, share some words with the journalists.
At some points, the player and the main character will attend and be the speaker in such events,  a desirable situation, as they are very useful to self-promote and gain additional “capital value”.

And that’s it for now.
Starting slow, because I can already imagine that eventually the page will be enriched with screenshots in all kinds of moments. But even if that ends up to be the case, the selection process for these screenshots will always be meaningful, but not too spoilerific.

I also invite you and everyone else to follow our twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/Time_Symmetry](Twitter)[/url]

There you may find additional information about story, art and characters.
It still on the early stages and much at this point, but more interesting stuff will be posted soon.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35001658/cf6a80faa1f991cb770765085a553f555dbe198e.jpg[/img]
